paragraphs: Two Notices for Healthy Week, posted by Lily. At the start of this term, Teacher Kim asked the Explorers to write a notice. The notice is for Healthy Week, and it is for the whole school. A good notice is short, and it gives the facts. On Thursday, we discussed the plan in the library. We wrote the first notice ourselves. Then Teacher Kim changed some parts. Here are both notices, so you can look for the differences.

This is our notice, the first version. Leo drew a small sun at the top. The title says, "Healthy Week." The first line says, "Everyone can come from Monday to Thursday." The second line says, "We start at half past seven in the morning." The third line says, "We meet on the school field." The next line says, "Bring a bottle of water." The last line says, "Listen to the instructions of Coach Matt."

This is the notice of Teacher Kim, the second version. Teacher Kim signed it at the bottom. The title says, "Healthy Week." The first line says, "Everyone can come from Monday to Friday." The second line says, "We start at seven o'clock in the morning." The third line says, "We meet on the wide school field." The next line says, "Bring a bottle of water and a hat." The last line says, "Listen to the instructions of Coach Matt."

The two notices have four differences. The first is the last day, Thursday or Friday. Teacher Kim chose Friday, because there is a game for all the classes on that day. The second is the time, because the sun is hot after eight o'clock. So Teacher Kim made the start earlier. The third is the field, and the wide field has more room. The last is the hat, because the sun is strong. Teacher Kim told us the reasons, and we agreed.

Healthy Week has more than sport. Every day, the school shop sells fruit and water. Exercise is good for our bodies, and healthy food is good too. Coach Matt will show us a short exercise every morning. Mia and Leo will take photos for the blog.
Which notice do you like more? I like the second one, because it has more facts. The first one is still in my notebook, and I will keep it. Next term, we will write a better notice by ourselves.
